The story is tightly unified around the theme of an unspoken, fleeting connection between two people at a temporary artistic residency. Every scene, detail, and piece of dialogue serves to build and resolve this central tension. Details introduced in the beginning—such as the laminated instructions, getting lost at the fourth roundabout, the scar on Anton's chin, the flush of his ears, and the goal of "touching the sea"—are all meaningfully revisited in the climax and resolution. The physical setting and plot events (crossing over to a hidden second beach, getting caught by the rising tide, and finally navigating the roundabout correctly "just in time" to leave) mirror the characters' emotional arc, creating a deeply harmonious and satisfying narrative whole.
